title: How to Build a Customer Support Portal Without Code (2026)
summary: Build a custom customer support portal with ticket management, agent assignments, and a customer-facing interface in an afternoon. Replace Zendesk's $55/agent/month with something you own.
body_markdown: For most teams under 20 agents, yes — 80–90% of what small teams actively use in Zendesk is ticket management, the customer portal, agent replies, and email notifications. All four are straightforward to build. What you give up: Zendesk's native AI triage, the 1,800-app marketplace, native mobile apps, and enterprise compliance certifications (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR). If you depend on those, keep Zendesk.
